audience: field service teams that run jobs, forms and CRM tasks in Formitize

useCases.title: Check which jobs are still open
useCases.text: List the unfinished jobs, or the finished ones. Open a job to read its client, status and attached forms, and its change history.

useCases.title: Review the newest submitted forms for a job
useCases.text: List submitted forms, newest first, filtered by job or template. Open one form to read its answers, the submitting user and the GPS position.

useCases.title: Read the field layout of a form template
useCases.text: List the form templates in the account. Open one template to read its elements and field types before you read its submitted answers.

useCases.title: Look up assets and lookup database tables
useCases.text: List the asset types and the assets of one type. Open an asset to read its client, location and field values. Check the lookup tables for their column names.

useCases.title: Follow up on CRM tasks
useCases.text: List CRM tasks, with optional filters. Open one task to read its related client or job and its attachments.

useCases.title: Create and update CRM tasks
useCases.text: Create a new CRM task. Each create call makes a new task, so list the tasks first to avoid duplicates. Update only the fields you pass on an existing task.
